description.text: Main Courses Information resource management, Information networking, Information retrieval, Information analysis and prediction, Network information management and information management, Enterprise competitive intelligence, Database design program, etc.

duration.text: The Information Resource Management at Soochow University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3-6 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required
